note: Both sets extract a large number of claims from the text and the table, but both also contain several errors. Set A incorrectly assigns the shear modulus value (80.8 GPa) to Young's modulus, misidentifies the top thickness (0.019 m) as the top diameter, and has two claims with incorrect units (N*m^3 instead of N*m^2). Set B also has two claims with the incorrect N*m^3 unit, misreads a mass density value (556.587 instead of 5590.87), and invents a height value (28.324 m) from a misread center of mass location. Because both sets have an equal number of significant errors, they are of similar quality.
